svg.title: Build first, then look. Build a rough version, analyze its outputs, and go back to build. For the invoice reader, run 20 invoices and note what went wrong with each: invoice 1 is fine, invoice 2 mixed up the invoice date with the due date, invoices 3 and 4 are fine. If date mix-ups keep showing up, that is the most common problem and the thing to measure next.
